title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 05:53:24 最新章节：第六千四百一十六章 出乎意料
content_zh:
黑源城，广阔无比的北原区域中一座不起眼的小城池。
这座小城虽然偏安一隅，却也有数百万人口，其中有大量的修士，数不清的各种势力，就算是晚上，都车水马龙，灯火辉煌。
将近傍晚，天空中乌云密布，远处有沉闷的雷声不断压迫而来，空气中荡漾着温润的水汽，没多久就开始电闪雷鸣。
天空之中，无数的霹雳疯狂的震响着，一道道雷蛇好似要撕破苍穹，瓢泼大雨，瀑布一般的倾泻下来。
在这种天气却有一个十六七岁的少年从城中奔跑出去，这个少年个头不高，有些消瘦，脸色在雨水中显得有些苍白，浑然不顾天空中瓢泼的的大雨，出了城之后一口气往三十里的一处山谷跑去。
这个少年明显不是普通人，一步数米，速度极快，半个时辰不到就闯进了山谷之中，一直跑到一颗参天古树面前才停下来。
“啊！”
少年忽然咆哮起来，仰天怒吼，满脸悲愤之色，接着竟然抡起拳头对着面前的大树捶打起来。
面前的参天古树足足有数人合抱，这么大的狂风之下树身几乎纹丝不动，很快少年的拳头开始有血迹流出，但是少年似乎没有感觉疼痛，依然在拼命的对着大树挥拳。
“为什么，为什么。”少年仰天怒吼。
咔嚓！咔嚓！咔嚓！
一道道粗大的雷蛇不断的撕裂天幕，似乎要摧毁大地。
嘭！嘭！嘭！
少年好像疯魔了一般，一边大吼一边疯狂的挥拳，鲜血混着雨水顺着手臂流落在地上。
“为什么我要受尽诸多苦难，为什么我要遭遇各种压迫，我不甘，老天，你来告诉我这都是为什么？”一连打了数百拳，少年终于停手，仰天大吼，但是声音很快就消失在天威之下。
咔嚓！
就在这时候，一道粗大无比的闪电从天而降，足足有百丈长，水缸粗细，好似上古神龙要毁灭大地，直接劈在了古树上面。
一声巨响，数人合抱的古树竟然化为了灰烬，少年呆呆的看着这一切，头脑嗡嗡作响，气血沸腾，眼前发黑，刚才天威之下连不知生长了多少年的参天古树都华为灰烬，少年侥幸安然无恙，但是也几乎吓傻。
就在少年发呆之际，又是一道雷电劈落，这道雷电比刚才那道还要粗大，闪耀发光，通体明亮，其中蕴含着毁灭的气息，这道粗大的雷电竟然准确的对着少年劈去，少年惊恐的看着越来越近的雷电，想要躲开，却根本不可能，任凭这道雷电劈在自己身上。
“啊。”

少年只是来得及大喊一声，然后就“噗通”一声栽倒在地，双眼紧闭，晕死了过去。
要是有其他人在这里肯定要大吃一惊，因为刚才那道雷电足足可以劈碎一个小山头，但是落在少年身上，竟然消失不见，就好像凭空消失，根本没有出现一般。
此时少年已经晕迷，而且本来心中也认为自己必死无疑，根本不知道雷电到了自己身上就消失无踪。
就在刚才，巨大的雷电落在少年身上的一瞬间，少年胸前忽然出现一股强大的吸力，轻易的把这道雷电吞噬其中，就好像一条不起眼的溪流流进了一望无尽的大海，连个浪花都没有翻起，令人奇怪的是这道雷电消失之后整个天空慢慢恢复了平静，雷电消失，只有漫天大雨不断滚落。
少年平躺在水洼上，周围雨水越来越多，眼看就要把少年淹没，这时候一道柔和的亮光从少年胸口蔓延出来，其中投射出一丝丝碧光，很快把少年包裹起来，就好像一个光罩，把周围的雨水挡在外面。
晕迷中少年脑海中混乱的画面不断的闪过，其中大部分都是少年从小至今的种种经历。
在少年的记忆中从小就是一个到处流浪的孤儿，身形单薄，四处乞讨，被人打，被狗咬，吃千家饭，漫无边际的流浪，一直到十岁被一个老头收留，老头是一个修士，把自己带到了一个门派，还给自己起了名字叫做陈枫。
自己从一个乞讨儿变成了一个修士，本以为可以改变一切，没想到依然是受尽了欺负，自己修炼并没有天赋，修行六年也只是刚刚入门，受尽了同门的嘲笑和白眼，尤其是在老修士死了之后，门派中更是把自己当成了一个废物对待，连修炼的丹药等一些材料都不再发给自己，这次自己跑出来的原因就是自己意外之中得悉老修士死的不明不白，想找高层问个清楚却被痛打了一顿。
这些片段占据了自己整个脑海，但是很快场面一变，陈枫就看到一道粗大的雷电对着自己劈来，这道雷电足以把自己劈成灰烬，但是却没进自己胸前消失不见。
这一次陈枫却看得清清楚楚，一幅幅画面似乎故意在脑海中放慢一般，这道可以劈碎大地的雷电竟然落在自己胸前的小塔上，然后消失不见，或者应该说这道雷电被自己胸前的小塔吸收了进去。
content_en:
Black Source City is an inconspicuous small city in the vast Beiyuan area.
Although this small town is relatively quiet, it still has a population of millions, including a large number of monks and countless various forces. Even at night, it is busy with traffic and brightly lit.
Towards evening, the sky was covered with dark clouds, and dull thunder continued to press in the distance. There was warm water vapor in the air, and soon lightning and thunder began.
In the sky, countless thunderbolts resounded crazily, and thunder snakes seemed to tear through the sky. Heavy rain poured down like waterfalls.
In this kind of weather, a sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy ran out of the city. This boy was short, a little thin, and his face looked a little pale in the rain. He ignored the pouring rain in the sky and ran towards a valley thirty miles away after leaving the city.
This young man was obviously no ordinary person. He could move several meters in one step and was extremely fast. He broke into the valley in less than half an hour and did not stop until he reached a towering ancient tree.
"Ah!"
The young man suddenly roared and looked up to the sky, his face full of grief and anger, and then he raised his fists and beat the big tree in front of him.
There were several people hugging the towering ancient tree in front of them. The tree body was almost motionless under such a strong wind. Soon blood began to flow from the young man's fist, but the young man seemed not to feel any pain and was still punching the big tree desperately.
"Why, why." The young man looked up to the sky and roared.
Click! Click! Click!
Thick thunder snakes continued to tear apart the sky, seeming to destroy the earth.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The young man seemed to be crazy, yelling and punching wildly, blood mixed with rain flowing down his arms and falling to the ground.
"Why do I have to suffer so much, why do I have to face all kinds of oppression, I am unwilling, God, please tell me why this is all?" After punching hundreds of times, the boy finally stopped and shouted to the sky, but his voice soon disappeared under the power of God.
Click!
At this moment, an extremely thick bolt of lightning fell from the sky, a hundred feet long and as thick as a water tank, as if an ancient divine dragon was about to destroy the earth and struck directly on the ancient tree.
There was a loud noise, and the ancient tree that was hugged by several people turned into ashes. The young man looked at all this blankly, his head was buzzing, his blood was boiling, and his eyes were black. Just now, under the power of God, even the towering ancient trees that had grown for countless years were reduced to ashes. The young man was lucky to be safe and sound, but he was almost scared to death.
Just when the boy was in a daze, another thunderbolt struck down. This thunderbolt was thicker than the one just now, shining brightly, and containing the aura of destruction. This thick thunderbolt struck the boy accurately. The boy looked at the lightning that was getting closer and closer in horror. He wanted to avoid it, but it was impossible. He let the thunderbolt hit him.
"Ah."
The young man just had time to shout, and then he fell to the ground with a thud, his eyes closed tightly, and he passed out.
If anyone else was here, they would definitely be surprised, because the lightning just now was enough to break a small hill, but when it fell on the young man, it disappeared, as if it disappeared out of thin air and did not appear at all.
At this time, the young man was already unconscious, and he thought that he would definitely die. He had no idea that the thunder and lightning would disappear without a trace when it hit him.
Just now, when a huge thunder and lightning fell on the boy, a strong suction force suddenly appeared on the boy's chest, which easily swallowed up the thunder and lightning. It was like an inconspicuous stream flowing into the endless sea without even a wave. What is strange is that after the thunder and lightning disappeared, the whole sky slowly returned to calm. The thunder and lightning disappeared, and only the heavy rain continued to roll down.
The boy was lying flat on the puddle. There was more and more rain around him, and it was about to submerge him. At this timeA soft light spread from the young man's chest, projecting a trace of green light, which quickly enveloped the young man, like a light shield, blocking out the surrounding rain.
Confusing images flashed through the mind of the comatose boy, most of which were the boy's experiences since childhood.
In the boy's memory, he was an orphan who wandered around since he was a child. He was thin, begging everywhere, being beaten by people, bitten by dogs, and eating thousands of meals. He wandered endlessly until he was taken in by an old man at the age of ten. The old man was a monk who took him to a sect and named himself Chen Feng.
I changed from a beggar to a monk. I thought I could change everything, but I didn't expect that I was still bullied. I had no talent in cultivation. I had just started practicing for six years. I suffered all the ridicule and look-downs from my fellow disciples, especially after the old monk died. , the sect treated him like a waste, and even stopped giving him training pills and other materials. The reason why he ran out this time was that he unexpectedly learned that the old monk died in an unknown way. He wanted to ask the higher-ups for details but was beaten up.
These fragments occupied his entire mind, but soon the scene changed, and Chen Feng saw a thick thunder and lightning striking at him. This thunder and lightning was enough to chop him into ashes, but it did not enter his chest and disappeared.
This time, Chen Feng could see clearly. The pictures seemed to be deliberately slowed down in his mind. The thunder and lightning that could break the earth fell on the small tower on his chest, and then disappeared. Or it should be said that the lightning was absorbed by the small tower on his chest.
